create_robust_regression_instance: create a RobustRegression instance with n, k, alpha_scale, beta_scale, beta_loc, and sigma_mean parameters
run_robust_regression_model: run the RobustRegression model method with an xarray Dataset containing X and Y data
extract_samples_from_numpyro: extract MCMC samples from NumPyro output into an xarray Dataset with alpha, beta, nu, and sigma
review_robust_regression_model: review the RobustRegression model using Student-T likelihood with Gamma-distributed degrees of freedom nu
refactor_robust_regression_priors: refactor the RobustRegression model to change the Normal, Gamma, or Exponential prior distributions
